text.text_excerpt: I have been here only infrequently and haven't ordered delivery in years because NY used to be notorious for taking forever on delivery. Popped in last Saturday amid the Coronavirus desertion hitting bars and restaurants for the $5 slice and a pint and was reminded- this is totally solid pizza. Not only that, but the $5 slice and a pint deal is a steal! I prefer cheese, but the deal includes other one topping slices and decent beer. It's not life changing, but it is pretty good! We had a fun time chatting with the bartender (as the only patrons) and playing music on the jukebox on our phones. I'll be back - when we are allowed - and will probably order delivery in the meantime.

I hate when I read a 5-star review for a place that has an average of 3 stars and the review starts like this: "I can't believe this place has such negative reviews!!!" That being said, I can't believe this place has such negative reviews!!! (sorry) I ate here for the first time last night and had no complaints. I've never ordered delivery from them or been in when it was busy so I can't speak to that. The service was great, they kept checking on me to see if I needed anything. When I'd finish a glass of wine they'd notice and ask if I wanted another. The pizza was the best I've had in NOLA, honestly. I got the Queens pizza so it was a "white" pizza, with olive oil instead of tomato sauce...

The bar side of NY Pizza (technically Bronx Bar) is awesome. It's my favorite low-key hangout. Pint and a slice is always $5--and we're talking high quality pizza, not some greasy reheated slice of cheese. They make the best bloody mary's. Bartenders are amazing, sweet, and happy to get you whatever you need. They've introduced me to several new excellent drinks! Food is great, drinks are great, but it's the ladies behind the counter that keep me coming back.
